recipes.title: CI drift report — one sticky, non-blocking PR comment
recipes.purpose: Post the skill's drift report as one sticky, non-blocking comment on every PR.

verify.run: node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),s=fs.readFileSync(".github/workflows/code-quality-drift.yml","utf8"),L=s.split("\n"),die=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};if(!/^on:$/m.test(s)||!/^  pull_request:$/m.test(s))die("no pull_request trigger");if(!/^  contents:[ ]read$/m.test(s)||!/^  pull-requests:[ ]write$/m.test(s))die("permissions must grant contents read and pull-requests write");const j=L.findIndex((l)=>/^jobs:$/.test(l));if(j<0)die("no jobs key");const n=L.slice(j+1).filter((l)=>/^  \S+:$/.test(l)).length;if(n!==1)die("expected 1 job, found "+n);const k=L.filter((l)=>/^      - /.test(l)).length;if(k!==5)die("expected 5 steps, found "+k);const w=["actions/checkout","actions/setup-node","fetch.mjs","plan.mjs --check","sticky-pull-request-comment"];let i=0;for(const l of L)if(i<w.length&&l.includes(w[i]))i++;if(i!==w.length)die("step order wrong, missing "+w.slice(i).join(", "));if(!/plan\.mjs --check.*\|\| true/.test(s))die("the check step must ignore the exit code");if(!/fetch\.mjs --no-record/.test(s))die("the fetch step must be read-only (--no-record)")'

practices.title: Keep AGENTS.md within the harness's budget
Confine `any` to the decoded boundary
A baseline is a ratchet, not a wall — and not a place to hide new debt
Make the CI check a required status check
The threshold reports, the rule gates — and a legacy hotspot gets a documented ceiling
Word the pointer so the agent reaches the material
Ignore a file only when the runner cannot execute it
Coverage is not verification
Triage dead code in fix order, and keep an export only through an auditable mechanism
Do not cache what the environment already says
An equivalent mutant is a decision, not a survivor
Format on write locally, check only in CI
Exclude generated files from the formatter's file set
Put the doc where the harness looks
Decide whether the hook fixes and re-stages, or fails
Put a gate in pre-commit only if it is fast
Run the hook's gates serially unless they are independent
Treat every client-side hook as skippable
Delete an instruction the model already obeys
Auto-fix what the tool can fix
Fix, suppress, or record — never ignore
Enable a rule only when its report is actionable
Severity is a switch, not a dial
A suppression explains itself
Relax in tests only what tests make meaningless
A marker comment must be valid in its target language
Run mutation on pull requests, not on every push
Pay for mutation testing only where someone acts on it
The score is a floor, never a target
Mutate production code, and decide what production code is
The TypeScript checker trades run time for honest survivors
A test that never fails is not a test
One reason to fail per test
Sweep the whole repo once, at the gate's scope
Staged-only locally, repo-wide in the gate
A survivor is a test that did not fail
Test behaviour, not implementation
Draw the unit boundary deliberately
Fixtures encapsulate setup, factories build data
Name the behaviour, not the method
`strict` is the floor; go past it deliberately
An assertion states the invariant it relies on
Decide whether to pay for type-aware linting
Verify a dead-code finding before you delete the code it names
